title: Minimum Size of a Poset Realizing $\Z_{2}\times\Z_{2^{n}}$ as its Automorphism Group
summary: We study the realization of finite groups as automorphism groups of finite posets. Given a finite group $G$, let $β(G)$ denote the smallest number of elements in a poset $P$ with $\Aut(P)\cong G$. While $β(G)$ is known for several cyclic and small abelian groups, the non-cyclic abelian case is largely open. In this paper we prove that $β(\Z_{2}\times\Z_{2^{n}})=2^{\,n+1}+2$ for every $n\ge 3$.
